threshold.buyer_grade: Venous-aware control reduces dangerous over/under-drainage events by >= 50% vs P_CSF-only control, under realistic disturbances, while preserving drainage >= 0.3 mL/min and ICP < 20 mmHg
threshold.ceiling: < 25% reduction — no material advantage over P_CSF-only

rationale: 50% reduction is clinically meaningful (halves dangerous events). 25% is the minimum detectable in a small trial.
